state_queries.scheduled: SELECT count(*) FROM absurd.t_long_horizon_bench WHERE state = 'sleeping'
state_queries.retryable: SELECT count(*) FROM absurd.t_long_horizon_bench WHERE state IN ('pending', 'running') AND attempts > 1
state_queries.dead: SELECT count(*) FROM absurd.t_long_horizon_bench WHERE state = 'failed'
state_queries.running: SELECT count(*) FROM absurd.t_long_horizon_bench WHERE state = 'running'

operator_notes: get_by_id: AsyncAbsurd.fetch_task_result (state only, so the handle is not checked); filters: the absurdctl list-tasks SELECT plus params @>; count: SQL on t_<queue>; pause: stop_worker/start_worker per replica
